Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.20 adds full in-game Japanese and Korean localization alongside Simplified Chinese and English. All story routes, choices, UI, items, news, short visits and endings use the selected language; missing keys fall back to English. The 1.19 cooperation-buyer narration fix, 1.18 HD CGs/maid schedule, 1.17 cross-mod compatibility and earlier fixes remain. 1.20 新增完整日语与韩语游戏内本地化，与简体中文、English 一并提供；剧情、路线、选项、UI、道具、新闻、短访与结局均随语言切换，缺失键回退英文。保留 1.19 合作买家旁白修复、1.18 高清 CG 与侍从线排期、1.17 跨 MOD 兼容及更早修复。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
